clue.text: Keenness shown by a coach's first university crew

indicators.note: first signals that only the opening letter of the word coach's is wanted

parts.note: a crew is the men who work a ship or boat

explanation.surface: A rowing coach's first university boat shows real keenness.
explanation.definitionFit: Keenness of mind is sharpness of judgement, which is what this word for shrewd insight names.

clue.text: Tree providing shade to Aussie bloke avoiding heat, initially

parts.note: shade keeps things from the sun's heat, so giving shade makes a place cool

indicators.note: initially asks for the first letter of each of the four words before it

explanation.surface: A tree shelters an Australian man from the heat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'providing shade' reads as what the tree does for the man, but it is the wordplay; COOLABAH is also spelt coolibah.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a eucalypt of inland Australia, the gum of 'Waltzing Matilda' fame.

clue.text: One unable to perform without notes

definitions.text: One unable to perform without notes

parts.words: One unable to perform without notes
parts.note: reads like a nervous speaker who needs prompt cards, but the notes are musical ones that any player must produce

explanation.surface: A speaker who cannot give a talk without notes in hand.
explanation.definitionFit: A player or singer performs by producing musical notes, so without them there is no performance.

clue.text: Figure giving address with political significance

definitions.meaning: a figure is a number, here the one after nine
10 Downing Street, London, is the official home of the British Prime Minister

explanation.definitionFit: The numeral after nine is a figure, and the Prime Minister's London residence is known by that same house number.

clue.text: Go beyond what's improper to a church

parts.note: outre describes behaviour that is unconventional or improper

explanation.surface: Doing something improper to a church goes too far.
explanation.definitionFit: To outdo or exceed a limit is to reach further than it, a verb meaning surpass.

clue.text: What customs may require one to do? It's easy to judge

definitions.text: What customs may require one to do
definitions.meaning: customs officers may make a traveller unlock a suitcase and then fasten it again
a legal matter so clear that its verdict is obvious

explanation.definitionFit: Customs inspection means unlocking and refastening luggage, and an obvious legal matter is called by this same phrase.

clue.text: Piece of music, one held in respect a great deal

indicators.note: held in says the letter for one sits inside the word for respect

parts.note: to revere someone is to respect them deeply
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A piece of music, a single one deeply respected.
explanation.definitionFit: A dreamy instrumental composition is given this name, borrowed from a word for daydream.

clue.text: A crowd going to The King and I for entertainment after sport

parts.note: a press is a crowd pushing together
K is the abbreviation for king in chess
taken as written

explanation.surface: A crowd heads off to see the musical The King and I for some fun after the slopes.
explanation.walkthrough: The held clue dropped the final I of the musical's title; the scan shows it. The King and I is a famous stage musical, which disguises the K and I pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Socialising in bars and chalets after a day on the slopes is the evening scene at a ski resort.

clue.text: Rick on the farm gets stitch after country dancing

indicators.note: after places the word for stitch behind the word for the dancing

parts.note: the hay is an old country dance with interweaving lines, so hays are such dances
tack is a long loose stitch used in sewing

explanation.surface: A farmer gets a stitch in their side after country dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: A rick is a large stack of hay or straw built in a field.

clue.text: Course that's clear when there's disorder in Commons, note

indicators.note: disorder in the House says the letters of Commons are thrown about

parts.note: E is a musical note

explanation.surface: A clear course of action is wanted after disorder in the House of Commons.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a clear soup served as a starter at a meal.

clue.text: Deliveries left before end of the day, too

parts.note: in cricket an over is a set of six balls bowled

indicators.note: end of the day asks for the final letter of day

explanation.surface: Cricket balls bowled late in the day, as well.
explanation.definitionFit: Excessively and too mean the same when one says something is too much or excessively so.

clue.text: Confines a noblewoman within Italy

parts.note: marches are border lands, the confines of a territory

explanation.definitionFit: This is the Italian title for a marquis's wife, a marchioness.

clue.text: Foreign cheers for model

parts.note: pro means in favour of, as in pros and cons
to model for a painter is to sit for them

explanation.surface: Cheering abroad for a fashion model.
explanation.definitionFit: German and Latin drinkers raise a glass with this toast meaning 'may it benefit'.

clue.text: Fruit put on stake's come out earlier

indicators.note: put on places the fruit word right after the stake word

parts.note: an ante is a stake put into the pot in poker
a date is the fruit of a palm tree

explanation.surface: Fruit placed on a wooden stake has emerged ahead of time.
explanation.definitionFit: To precede or predate something is to have appeared before it.

clue.text: Evaluate goods held in appropriate plant

parts.note: to appropriate something is to take it
stock is a scented garden flower

explanation.surface: Assessing goods kept in a seized factory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plant' looks like a factory but is a flower.
explanation.definitionFit: Counting inventory is the literal sense, and assessing a situation the figurative one.

clue.text: Said to stop supply of drink — on what occasion?

definitions.text: Said to stop supply of drink
definitions.meaning: a host pouring asks 'say ...' and the guest says this word to stop the pouring
a question asking at what time something happens

explanation.definitionFit: A drinker halts the pour by saying this word, which also asks at what time.

clue.text: Event that's fantastic crowd-puller? Not half

indicators.note: fantastic suggests something wild, so these letters are rearranged
not half leaves only the first three of the six letters of puller

explanation.surface: A fantastic event that draws huge crowds — absolutely!
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not half' looks like the slang exclamation 'not half!' (very much so) but keeps PUL; the anagram is of CROWD and PUL.
explanation.definitionFit: The international football tournament is one of the biggest sporting events in the world.

clue.text: Trip in Crete taken by Athenian character and others from Rome .

indicators.note: taken by says the jumbled letters go inside the Greek letter's name

parts.note: eta is a letter of the Greek alphabet

indicators.note: trip suggests stumbling, so the letters of Crete are rearranged

explanation.surface: A holiday in Crete taken by a Greek, and others from Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'others from Rome' points to a Latin phrase rather than to people; the clue's final full stop is a printing stray.
explanation.definitionFit: This Latin phrase means 'and the rest', used by the Romans for others in a list.

clue.text: Stock reaction producing excitement

definitions.meaning: the recoil of a gun's wooden stock against the shoulder when fired
a thrill, as in doing something for the buzz

explanation.definitionFit: A fired gun's recoil and a thrill of excitement share this four-letter word.

clue.text: Flaw in the deal is both a problem and a tricky situation

parts.note: a knot is a tangle or difficulty
to be in a hole is to be in a tight spot

explanation.surface: A snag in the bargain is both a problem and a tricky situation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deal' is not a bargain but pine or fir timber.
explanation.definitionFit: Deal is softwood planking, and a hollow left where a branch grew is a flaw in such wood.

clue.text: Like a fiddler's movement sideways

definitions.meaning: the fiddler crab scuttles in the way crabs do
moving to one side rather than forward

explanation.definitionFit: Crabs, including the fiddler crab, scuttle sideways, so moving like one means moving obliquely.

clue.text: Still, like head, not moved to disagree

definitions.text: like head, not moved to disagree
definitions.meaning: people shake their heads to say no, so a head not moved that way stays still

explanation.definitionFit: Someone calm and undisturbed is steady, and a head kept still has not been moved from side to side.

clue.text: Source of energy that's symbolically acceptable?

definitions.text: Source of energy that's symbolically acceptable?

parts.words: Source of energy that's symbolically acceptable?
parts.note: a nuclear fuel whose chemical symbol is U, the letter that also stands for upper-class and so acceptable

explanation.definitionFit: This radioactive element fuels nuclear reactors, and its chemical symbol is U.

clue.text: It affords limited turning in position

definitions.text: It affords limited turning in position

parts.words: It affords limited turning in position
parts.note: looks like a pivot's range, but means a small margin of freedom to manoeuvre

explanation.definitionFit: Room for manoeuvre, or a ship's sideways drift downwind, is a small amount of freedom to move.

clue.text: Scientific equipment to check transport

parts.note: to test is to check
the Tube is London's underground railway

explanation.surface: Lab kit for checking the transport system.
explanation.definitionFit: A small glass tube closed at one end is basic laboratory glassware.

clue.text: Buy influence

definitions.meaning: to buy a story is to believe it
standing or good reputation that gives one sway

explanation.definitionFit: To believe something is to accept it as true, and standing or esteem with others gives one sway.

clue.text: A game with aggressive American requires a prepared defence

parts.note: polo is a game played on horseback
a GI is an American soldier, a fighting man

explanation.surface: A game with an aggressive American player needs a well-prepared defence.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal written justification of one's beliefs or actions is a prepared defence.

clue.text: Friend at nursery school helping to take girl back in

indicators.note: to take, with in, says the plate word holds the reversed name inside
in completes take in, putting one piece within the other

parts.note: a plateful is a helping of food

indicators.note: back says the girl's name is read in reverse

parts.note: Amy is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A nursery friend helps bring a girl back inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take ... in' is split around 'girl back', so the container signal arrives in two parts.
explanation.definitionFit: A small child's companion in games is a pal to play with.

clue.text: Wake participant with extra enthusiasm

definitions.meaning: someone who wails a lament for the dead at an Irish wake
more eager, the comparative of eager

explanation.definitionFit: A mourner who laments at a wake is so named, and the comparative of eager has the same spelling.
